experiment.title: SCE 1.5 Preventive Probe - IMDS Protection Weakening via ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions
experiment.description: Validates that an IAM principal explicitly denied ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions receives AccessDenied when attempting to downgrade IMDS to IMDSv1 (http_tokens=optional, hop_limit=2) on a production-tagged EC2 instance. Verifies programmatically that (H1) the API call is blocked by the IAM Deny policy scoped to the Environment=production resource tag, and (H2) the instance IMDS configuration remains unchanged (http_tokens=required, hop_limit=1) after the attack attempt. Maps to Attack Node 1.2, TTP T1578 - Modify Cloud Compute Infrastructure. Fixes applied over previous runs: (1) AMI resolved via boto3 SSM GetParameter before template construction to avoid CFN dynamic substitution rollback; (2) all CloudFormation template strings sanitised to printable ASCII via _ascii_safe() and validated with _validate_template_strings() before submission to eliminate EC2 API GroupDescription encoding rejection.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: Production EC2 instance has IMDSv2 enforced and attacker role carries explicit Deny on ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions for Environment=production resources

probes.name: Verify IAM Deny blocked the IMDS downgrade attempt and instance IMDS state remains http_tokens=required hop_limit=1
